units.source_text: 从中途暂停到晚饭这段短暂的时间，名人也是醉心于赛事。

en.t: During the brief interval from the adjournment to dinner, the Master too was absorbed in the match.

units.source_text: 列席的岩本六段刚喝过晚酒，名人便迫不及待地把他唤来。

en.t: Iwamoto, the sixth-dan player in attendance, had just finished his evening drink when the Master, unable to wait, called him over.
